attributes.label: Referrer type
attributes.purpose: The tracker's referrer class, the base of the shipped channel rules.
attributes.data: 1 direct, 2 search, 3 website, 6 campaign, 7 social; 0 when missing. Taken at the session's first action.

attributes.label: Referrer name
attributes.purpose: Which site or search engine sent the session.
attributes.data: The referrer name at the session's first action, lowercased and trimmed; empty when there is none.

attributes.label: UTM source
attributes.purpose: The utm_source tag the session landed with.
attributes.data: The session's first utm_source session tag, else custom_var_k5 at its first action; lowercased and trimmed; empty when the session carries neither.

attributes.label: Source or referrer
attributes.purpose: One source per session whether or not it was tagged; the closest match to GA4's session source.
attributes.data: utm_source when it is not empty, else the referrer name; empty for a direct session.

attributes.label: UTM medium
attributes.purpose: The utm_medium tag the session landed with, such as paid, email, or cpc.
attributes.data: The session's first utm_medium session tag, else custom_var_v1 at its first action; lowercased and trimmed; empty when untagged.

attributes.label: UTM campaign
attributes.purpose: The campaign the session landed from; the key ad spend joins on.
attributes.data: The session's first utm_campaign session tag, else custom_var_v4 at its first action; trimmed, case kept; empty when untagged.

attributes.label: Returning flag
attributes.purpose: Whether the tracker had seen the browser before.
attributes.data: 1 when the visit's returning flag is set at its first action; 0 for a new or unflagged visit. A browser id, not a person.

attributes.label: Country
attributes.purpose: Where the session came from.
attributes.data: The location country code at the session's first action, trimmed; empty when unknown.

attributes.label: Ordered
attributes.purpose: Whether the session placed an order.
attributes.data: 1 when the session has an order in the period; 0 otherwise.

attributes.label: Started checkout
attributes.purpose: Whether the session reached checkout.
attributes.data: 1 when the session has a checkout_started event in the period; 0 otherwise.

attributes.label: Rage clicked
attributes.purpose: Whether the session showed frustration.
attributes.data: 1 when the session has a rage click in the period; 0 otherwise.

attributes.label: Device
attributes.purpose: The device class of the session, the viewport the trend rows split by.
attributes.data: desktop, tablet, or mobile from the device type at the session's first action; unknown otherwise.

attributes.label: Browser
attributes.purpose: The browser of the session; separates in-app browsers from Safari and Chrome.
attributes.data: The browser name at the session's first action, trimmed; empty when unknown.

attributes.label: City
attributes.purpose: The city of the session, for a regional question inside one country.
attributes.data: The location city at the session's first action, trimmed; empty when unknown.

attributes.label: Region
attributes.purpose: The state or region of the session.
attributes.data: The location region at the session's first action, trimmed; empty when unknown.

attributes.label: Operating system
attributes.purpose: The operating system of the session.
attributes.data: The OS code at the session's first action, trimmed; empty when unknown.

attributes.label: Screen resolution
attributes.purpose: The screen size the session reported; a headless browser or a broken tag reports 0x0 or an impossible size.
attributes.data: The resolution at the session's first action, such as 1920x1080, trimmed and lowercased; empty when unknown.

attributes.label: Landing page type
attributes.purpose: What kind of page the session started on, so a source can be read by where it lands.
attributes.data: The page type of the session's first recorded heatmap page: home, pdp, plp, cart, and the rest. A session whose first page has no heatmap is classed by the first page that has one.

attributes.label: Landing path
attributes.purpose: The page the session started on, as a URL path; the key a site catalog joins on.
attributes.data: The URL path of the session's first recorded heatmap page, lowercased, without host, query, or a trailing slash; (unknown) when the session has no recorded page.

attributes.label: Landing page id
attributes.purpose: The heatmap page the session started on.
attributes.data: The idsitehsr of the session's first recorded heatmap page; 0 when the session has no recorded page.

attributes.label: Second page type
attributes.purpose: What kind of page the session went to after it landed, so a landing page's next step can be read by source.
attributes.data: The page type of the session's second recorded heatmap page, counting repeated views of one page as one: home, pdp, plp, cart, and the rest; (exit) when the session saw one page; (unknown) when it has no recorded page.

attributes.label: Second page path
attributes.purpose: The page the session went to after it landed, as a URL path.
attributes.data: The URL path of the session's second recorded heatmap page, counting repeated views of one page as one, lowercased, without host, query, or a trailing slash; (exit) when the session saw one page; (unknown) when it has no recorded page.

attributes.label: Third page type
attributes.purpose: What kind of page the session reached two steps after it landed.
attributes.data: The page type of the session's third recorded heatmap page, counting repeated views of one page as one; (exit) when the session saw fewer than three pages; (unknown) when it has no recorded page.

attributes.label: Third page path
attributes.purpose: The page the session reached two steps after it landed, as a URL path.
attributes.data: The URL path of the session's third recorded heatmap page, counting repeated views of one page as one, lowercased, without host, query, or a trailing slash; (exit) when the session saw fewer than three pages; (unknown) when it has no recorded page.
